customManagers.description: Track kubestellar/hive origin/v2 as a pinned commit SHA. The SHA is duplicated in the launcher, the image, and the README, and tests/image-contract.sh plus validate.yml require all three to agree, so one depName keeps every match in a single Renovate branch and PR.
matchStrings: layers the pinned Hive runtime at `(?<currentDigest>[0-9a-f]{40})`

packageRules.description: Latest upstream is the project posture (AGENTS.md): every update automerges — digest, pin, patch, minor, and major alike. A pin is a checkpoint the automation moves, never a human gate.
Keep the FSDK lab-runner base image digest in image/Containerfile current
